# Orthogonal surface\-normal gradient scheme

The vector d\\vec{d}d joining two cell centres is parallel to the
normal direction of the inter\-connecting face.

∇f⊥Q\=QP−QN∣d∣ \\snGrad Q \= \\frac{Q\_P \- Q\_N}{\| \\vec{d} \|}∇f⊥​Q\=∣d∣QP​−QN​​
![Schematic](data:image/png;base64,)

## Properties

* Calculated using a central difference scheme using the mesh delta coefficients
* Any non\-orthogonality is ignored

## Usage

The scheme is specified using:

```
snGradSchemes
{
    default         none;
    snGrad(Q)       orthogonal;
}

```
